biod: Enable setting context in match mode. To remove a fingerprint, the user must be in the fingerprint list UI, which implies FPMCU is in match mode. FPMCU currently does not allow resetting context when mode is not none, so let FPMCU exit match mode, then reset context, then enter match mode again. biod: Check firmware template version on boot. On boot, before setting FP TPM seed, send command to FPMCU to check firmware template version. Do not send TPM seed if template version is not compatible with biod's. This check allows biod to deal with older versions of firmware in bio_crypto_init. Also add unit tests for this check. biod: Make record reads/writes depend on positive match secret support. If FPMCU does not support positive match secret, do not write a validation value field to record; write record with format version 1. If FPMCU supports positive match secret, write validation value to record with record format version 2. If the record format version indicates that there is not validation value field, do not read this field from record, but load an empty validation value. TEST=enrolled templates without positive match secret support, then updated biod and FPMCU to support positive match secret (but not migration yet), verified that old templates can be read back from storage. chromeos-config: match ARM architecture more broadly veyron_mighty uses the architecture string "armv7l", which we did not account for in our list of machine types. More broadly match arm machine types by looking for "arm" or "aarch64" as the beginning of the string. The reason this matters is veyron_mighty, despite being non-unibuild, needs to fallback to mosys, and architecture detection needs to happen before mosys can be run. arc-setup: change initialization of CrosConfig With CL:1809879, CrosConfig::InitModel() will no longer return false on non-unibuild platforms, as fallback support to mosys was added to libcros_config.
